description: Hi, I'm Shayan, a 4th-year CS student in Toronto with front-end and back-end experience and an interest in UI and AI. I'm building a team to create software that monitors astronaut health. Join for real-world impact and hands-on experience, whether it's your first hackathon or not. Looking for data science/ML, UI/UX, back-end, or health science skills. Curious and excited to build? Message me!
